🚨 Alexis Mac Allister on his future: “Everything can happen before I am a free agent”.

“We are in a situation where I have a year and a half left on my contract, where last season it was conveyed to me that the club’s idea was not to renew my contract, at least for now. And we’ll, obviously it was painful situation”.

“I still had time or still have time left at this club, which is what I want most, to continue here”.

“The reality is that the manager has changed, the sporting director has changed, and new investors are coming into the club. So I think today I am in a position where anything can happen, and well, we will see in the future. I am happy here”, told @gastonedul @losedul.

🚨🤍 Real Madrid club statement on Rafa Nadal.

The Board of Directors of Real Madrid C.F., meeting today, Wednesday, November 4, has agreed to submit the ratification of the appointment of Rafael Nadal Parera—member number 67,778 of our club—as a new member of the Board of Directors to the General Assembly of Representative Members.

Rafael Nadal, an honorary member of Real Madrid, is one of the greatest legends in the history of sport and one of the most admired and recognized Spanish athletes worldwide.

It is a source of immense pride for Real Madrid and the entire *madridista* community that a figure of his stature—both in terms of sporting achievement and personal character, and a true icon of Spanish and global sport—should join our Board of Directors, contributing from this position to the present and future of our club.

With an extraordinary record—including 92 individual titles, 22 Grand Slam trophies, two Olympic gold medals, five Davis Cup victories with Spain, and a stint as the world’s number-one-ranked player—Rafael Nadal has carved out a legendary sporting career. Yet, he represents far more than just his successes: his talent, his constant drive for self-improvement, his capacity for sacrifice, his competitive spirit, his humility, his respect for both rivals and teammates, and his commitment to helping others make him an exemplary figure, both on and off the court.

These values ​​are core to the identity of Real Madrid; Rafael Nadal has embodied and championed them throughout his entire sporting career, becoming an inspiration to millions of people across the globe.
— Fabrizio Romano (@FabrizioRomano)
